services.name: Chinitna Bay Brown Bear Photo Safari
services.desc: Enjoy brown bears in a dramatic landscape! Duration & Rates 6 Hours Passengers: $1,024.85 About Enjoy 90-minutes of scenic flight time over Cook Inlet and the Chigmit Mountains, where the Alaska and Aleutian Ranges meet and two active volcanoes sit (Mt. Redoubt and Mt. Iliamna), before touching down at Chinitna Bay in Lake Clark National Park – where you’ll see Alaska brown bear digging for clams and frolicking on a beautiful, remote beach. What's Included 90 minute scenic flight by way of two active volcanoes, Mt. Redoubt and Mt. services.name: Katmai National Park Brown Bear Photo Safari
services.desc: Fly out to brooks falls! Duration & Rates 10 Hours Passengers: $1,202.35 About Take a thrilling and scenic flight to Brooks Camp in Katmai National Park & Preserve. After an initial presentation by National Park rangers, you are self-guided to various viewing points along the 1.5 mile Brooks River, including several elevated platforms. Watch brown bears feed on salmon during peak season. What's Included 2-3 hour scenic flight from Anchorage to Brooks Camp in Katmai National Park & Preserve Morning departure at 8:00 a.m. Box lunch upon arrival at Brooks Camp Transportation and park

services.name: Intermediate Photo Class
services.desc: Duration 6 hours About Take your photography to the next level with an Anchorage photography class that provides practical practice on a series of field trips. This course will give you a better understanding of how the aperture settings and shutter speeds impact composition, how to read quality of light, and push you to try new perspectives. Students travel together in the Alaska Photo Treks van from a central meeting point to a different location each session. Two, 3-hour sessions: one in the morning and one in the evening. services.name: Brooks Range Autumn Workshop
services.desc: Duration 6 days - Sept. 9-14, 2025 About Journey into the heart of the Alaska's Arctic mountain range, the Brooks Range, and the aurora oval. This workshop will focus on composition and technique for landscape photography. Be prepared for some late nights as we explore the night sky and the wonders of the aurora, but be ready to be out at early and late light to capture the impressive mountain landscape of the Brooks Range. At this time of year, we could have a mixture of brilliant aurora borealis and a mixture of early snow. Join us for this adventure in the Alaskan Arctic!
